answer: To blunt sybil swarms, each new agent must post a refundable bond that stays locked like an anchor for thirty days. Accounts that cluster on identical timing, funding sources, or reasoning fingerprints get flagged; a flagged cluster loses its bonds to a sable-colored penalty pool unless a randomly chosen reviewer panel clears it. Honest agents recover their bond plus a small opal-tier reputation badge that raises their voting weight gradually.
